scripts.build: pnpm --filter @tablaria/shared build && pnpm --filter tablaria-backend --filter tablaria-frontend build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @tablaria/shared build && pnpm --parallel --filter tablaria-backend --filter tablaria-frontend --filter @tablaria/shared dev
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter tablaria-backend test:e2e && pnpm --filter tablaria-e2e test
